name: genesis-conductor-lidlift-mcp
description: LidLift MCP tool-dissonance control plane and prompt-to-tool fit scoring system by Igor Holt (@invariantx) for Genesis Conductor. Scores prompt-to-tool alignment before execution, enforces explicit guardrails (allow/review/clarify/block), ranks safer alternatives via deterministic heuristics + optional AI narrative, and exposes production-grade remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers. Features vendor-native tool discovery for OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Gemini with caching and auto-detection; Next.js operator console at lidlift.optimizationinversion.com; shared Zod schemas across web, API, and MCP layers. Composes seamlessly with OpenClaw / ClawHub skills (grok-persistent-state, mcp-openclaw-bridge, smithery-mcp-orchestrator) for reliable agentic orchestration, MCP integration, and thermodynamic verification patterns. Essential MCP guardrail infrastructure in the LID-LIFT Technical Suite powering production AI agent systems.
